_about: What each gallery image shows, read from the script that drew it (the array passed to brand_cmaps.field_image and its normalisation). collect.py copies `field`, `colour` and `extent` (the region the image covers) into web/public/gallery/manifest.json; the card and the lightbox show them. Visual descriptions stay in the alt text of the run's metadata.

kelvin-helmholtz-vorticity.field: Vorticity ω = −∇²ψ (the component normal to the plane) of two rolled-up shear layers at t = 7.
kelvin-helmholtz-vorticity.colour: Colour: ω, red for negative, black at zero, glass green for positive; the scale ends at the 99.7th percentile of |ω| (larger values saturate).
kelvin-helmholtz-vorticity.extent: Periodic box 4 × 2 (x × z, lengths in units of the layer velocity scale), the full box.

kelvin-helmholtz-dye.field: Concentration c of a passive dye that starts as the central band, at t = 7; the yellow-green line is c = 1/2.
kelvin-helmholtz-dye.extent: Periodic box 4 × 2 (x × z), the full box.

rayleigh-benard.field: Temperature T (the full temperature, conduction profile included) of 2D convection at Ra = 10⁶.
rayleigh-benard.colour: Colour: T, from −A (black) to +A (light grey), with A the 99th percentile of |T| in the interior |z| < 0.4; the boundary layers, which reach ±1/2, saturate.
rayleigh-benard.extent: Box 4 × 1 (x × z), periodic in x, walls at z = ±1/2; lengths in units of the layer depth.

kuramoto-sivashinsky-l22.field: The solution u(x, t) of the Kuramoto–Sivashinsky equation, L = 22: x upwards, t to the right.
kuramoto-sivashinsky-l22.colour: Colour: u, red for negative, black at zero, glass green for positive; the scale ends at the 99.7th percentile of |u|.
kuramoto-sivashinsky-l22.extent: x from 0 to 22 (periodic) upwards; t from 300 to 550 to the right.

taylor-couette-mode.field: Azimuthal velocity u_φ of the critical axisymmetric mode in the meridional (z, r) plane, with streamlines of the meridional flow (u_r, u_z).
taylor-couette-mode.colour: Colour: u_φ normalised to a largest magnitude of 1, red for negative, black at zero, glass green for positive.
taylor-couette-mode.extent: Gap r_i ≤ r ≤ r_o (outer wall at the top) over two axial wavelengths 2π/k, k = 3.1625.

swift-hohenberg.field: The field u(x, y) of the Swift–Hohenberg equation at r = 0.1, t = 600.
swift-hohenberg.colour: Colour: u, from −max |u| (black, troughs) to +max |u| (light grey, crests).

rossby-haurwitz.field: Relative vorticity ζ (the radial component of the curl of the velocity) of the shallow-water flow after 14 days.
rossby-haurwitz.colour: Colour: ζ, red for negative, black at zero, glass green for positive, scaled to the largest |ζ|.
rossby-haurwitz.extent: Unit sphere in orthographic projection, seen from 35° N.

orr-sommerfeld-mode.field: Streamwise velocity perturbation u = Re(û(y) exp(iαx)) of the least stable Orr–Sommerfeld mode, over one wavelength.
orr-sommerfeld-mode.colour: Colour: u normalised to a largest |û| of 1, red for negative, black at zero, glass green for positive.
orr-sommerfeld-mode.extent: Channel −1 ≤ y ≤ 1 over one wavelength 2π/α = 2π in x.

pipe-mode.field: Axial velocity u_z = Re(û_z(r) exp(iφ)) at z = 0 of the centre mode (left) and the wall mode (right).
pipe-mode.colour: Colour: u_z, each panel normalised to a largest |û_z| of 1, red for negative, black at zero, glass green for positive.
pipe-mode.extent: Each panel is the pipe cross-section, radius 1.

christensen-shell.field: Radial velocity u_r in the equatorial plane, seen from the north pole.
christensen-shell.colour: Colour: u_r, red for negative (inward), black at zero, glass green for positive (outward), scaled to the largest |u_r|.
christensen-shell.extent: Equatorial plane of the shell, r_i/r_o = 0.35 (outer radius at 0.47 of the image height), state at t = 1 viscous time.

channel-retau180-streaks.field: Streamwise velocity u = U(y) + u′ (mean plus fluctuation) in the wall-parallel plane y⁺ = 15.
channel-retau180-streaks.colour: Colour: u, from its 0.5th percentile (black) to its 99.8th percentile (light grey), display gamma 1.6.
channel-retau180-streaks.extent: Wall-parallel plane 4π × 2π (x × z, half-heights), flow left to right.

channel-hydrogen-bubbles.field: Positions of Lagrangian particles released from a spanwise wire at y⁺ = 10 (yellow-green dots), over the streamwise velocity fluctuation u′ at y⁺ ≈ 7.7.
channel-hydrogen-bubbles.colour: Colour: u′, from its 0.5th percentile (black) to its 99.8th percentile (light grey).
channel-hydrogen-bubbles.extent: Wall-parallel plane 4π × 2π (x × z, half-heights), flow left to right.
